subject: Detail for uploading data with application bundle

messages.author: ec7b8822421acd45
messages.subject: Detail for uploading data with application bundle
parts: Hi and thanks for reading my question. I have an application that reads from text data files. I intend to include the data files when I publish the app to Shinyapps.io (using RStudio publish). My questions is do I have to include the data files each time I republish my app to Shiny? I'm hoping the files will remain and I can just update the server.r and ui.r files. Thanks.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Detail for uploading data with application bundle
parts:
You can write R code to traverse the directory structure and log the output, but there is no means for browsing it.

That said, the contents are exactly what you deployed, with the caveat that if you allow users to upload files or if you fetch files remotely, those might also be present. However, those files are transient, and will not be present when the application resumes from sleeping.

See http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/Storage.html for more information.
